dsk.text: Marina Vendrell is sixteen when she and her parents buy and move into the House, where she is bullied at school, and in the basement she discovers the demon Valgavoth and befriends him.
He becomes her only real friend, and after vicious bullying she lures her four tormentors to the basement, where he devours them.

Empowered, Valgavoth hunts, the house warps and expands, and her parents vanish, so Marina threatens to burn it down, and he agrees to give her back the world as she remembered it, but the house keeps expanding until it swallows the plane.

Years later Zimone and Tyvar find her, and she denies wrongdoing as the House shifts back to its nightmarish form, but they retrieve her diary, which shows she enabled Valgavoth to take over the plane.
